_help: Maps a deggo (models.deggo.fyi) model slug to the canonical unified-model id it should be attributed to, when deggo stores the rating under a slug that does not match our id for the real release. Example: deggo rates slug 'deepseek-v4-flash' but names the entry 'Flash 0731' (release 2026-07-31), which is our 'deepseek-v4-flash-0731'; the undated 'deepseek-v4-flash' preview row is left unrated. Key = deggo slug, value = our canonical unified id. Contributor-maintained; keep entries sorted A-Z by key.
